name: Tofo Beach
tagline: The village, the dive shops and the main beach
description: The centre of everything here: a short strip of sand-track roads behind a wide arc of beach, with the dive operators, the beach bars, the market and most of the accommodation. Everything in Tofo is within a fifteen-minute walk of this point.
bestFor: Divers and anyone who wants to walk to everything
pros: All the dive operators are here
Beach bars and the village market
cons: Busiest part of Tofo in high season
Internet is weakest when the village fills
Sand tracks are hard going after rain

name: Tofinho
tagline: The point south of the village, quieter
description: The headland immediately south of Tofo, with a surf break off the point, a small memorial to those killed in the independence struggle and a scattering of houses and guesthouses on the dune. It is ten minutes on foot from the village and much calmer.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting quiet within walking distance of the village
cons: Nothing in the way of services
Steeper walk back from the village

name: Barra
tagline: The peninsula north with the calm-water side
description: A sandy peninsula about twenty minutes north where the ocean meets Inhambane Bay, with lodges along both shores, kitesurfing on the bay side and a lighthouse at the tip. It is more resort-shaped than Tofo and the water is calmer.
bestFor: Kitesurfers and anyone wanting calmer water and more comfort
pros: Calm bay water for kitesurfing and swimming
cons: Twenty minutes from Tofo's dive scene
Four-wheel drive needed on the sand tracks

name: Inhambane
tagline: The old town with the market, the bank and the dhows
description: The provincial town twenty-five minutes inland on the bay, one of the oldest settlements on this coast, with a Portuguese cathedral, a mosque, a working dhow harbour and the market that supplies Tofo. It is where anything administrative gets done.
bestFor: Anyone needing a bank, a market or an immigration office
pros: Banks, market and immigration all here
Much cheaper food than the beach
cons: No swimming or diving from the town
